_about: R1b inventory (BRIEF 12.1): module-level names bound to a value built from rel(), frozen at import and joined elsewhere as root / CONST, so they would bypass path() and R1c's new-then-old lookup. Closed list: a new name fails test_no_new_rel_constants; R1c removes entries as it routes them through path() (the list may only shrink). Since R1c-2 no entry of a MOVING file may be joined to a root (test_shipwright_paths_constant_joins.py); since R1c-3 sets, pathspecs and regexes recognise both places (known_rels) and labels use name(); what remains is the event log (it does not move) and churn_merge.TEST_RESULTS (the legacy file name tests write; sets use TEST_RESULTS_RELS).
